art.caption: Human life returns to the rhythms of the biosphere.

jobs.purpose: A timber canoe links two seasonal landings. Its paddle strokes stop at shore; the craft fits S4’s portable tools and seasonal movement.
A single deer walks between shelter and a browsing clearing, then stops to feed. This species is an artistic choice for S4’s woodland.
